lead: Things for writing, recording, organising and calculating at a desk, from collectable fountain pens, inks, notebooks and vintage machines to everyday pens, paper, filing and office equipment; organised by what you do with them, with archetypes for hobby items and buying criteria for everyday ones.

depts.note: Hobbyist area: filling system → line (archetype) → generation (version) → nib and finish (detail).

s.brief: Split the old flat list of 68 models into kinds by filling system; turn models into archetypes (line) with versions (generations, sizes, reference numbers) and details (nib, finish). Must-have icons: Pelikan Souverän M400/M600/M800/M1000 (piston), Montblanc Meisterstück 149/146, Lamy 2000, TWSBI Eco/580/Vac700R, Pilot Custom 823 (plunger) and Custom 74/742/743/845, Pilot Vanishing Point and Capless, Sailor Pro Gear and 1911, Platinum #3776 Century, Parker 51 (aerometric/vacumatic), Parker Duofold, Parker Vacumatic, Sheaffer Balance, Snorkel, PFM and Lifetime, Esterbrook J, Waterman Patrician, Conklin crescent filler, Lamy Safari/AL-star, Kaweco Sport, Pilot Metropolitan and Kakuno, Platinum Preppy, Aurora 88/Optima, Visconti Homo Sapiens, Montegrappa, Namiki/Pilot maki-e, Nakaya urushi, Danitrio, Omas, Faber-Castell/Graf von Faber-Castell, Cross. Add urushi/maki-e (Wajima, Namiki) and celluloid traditions to the tradition register; pen makers to the brand register. Order by significance (originators first), never alphabetical. Drop novelty/SKU-only entries (Keyno, Komamono, Writech etc.) unless they anchor an archetype.

k.brief: Most modern pens: Lamy Safari, Kaweco Sport, Sailor Pro Gear, Pilot Custom 74/742, Platinum 3776, Montblanc 146 is piston (not here). Include urushi/maki-e pens (Nakaya, Namiki) here unless eyedropper.

s.brief: Inks by maker → line → colour (archetype = line; versions = named colours). Herbin 1670/Encre, Diamine, Montblanc, Waterman Serenity Blue, Parker Quink, Rohrer & Klingner (Salix/Scabiosa iron gall), Noodler's, Kaweco, Lamy, De Atramentis. s.brief: Approved collector machines shelf.
